brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected the possibility of governing with Arab parties, calling such a coalition "a shame and a disgrace," Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu's comments reflect the hardline stance of his current coalition partners and his positioning ahead of potential government formation discussions.

Arab parties have previously sought roles in Israeli governments, but Netanyahu's rejection signals his preference to build a coalition without them.
dek: Coalition with Arab parties would be ‘a shame and a disgrace’, Netanyahu says Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said a coalition with Arab parties to form a government would be “a shame and a disgrace".
title: Netanyahu calls Arab coalition partners shameful and disgraceful
